modeHelp.identity: Keeps the face from your photos and puts the person in a scene you describe. Runs on PuLID with FLUX.1-dev.
modeHelp.edit: Changes something in the photo and keeps the rest: same picture, same pose.
modeHelp.expand: Extends the picture past its edges and fills the new area to match.
modeHelp.background: Cuts the subject out and leaves a transparent background.

loading: Reading what this machine can do…
capabilitiesFailed: Could not read what this machine can edit: {{message}}

photos.facesHelp: Up to three photos of the same person. PuLID averages their faces into one likeness.
photos.referencesHelp: Another person, object or style to bring into the edit. Only Qwen-Image-Edit uses them.
photos.drop: Drop a photo here or click to choose one
photos.uploadFailed: The photo could not be added: {{message}}
photos.notAnImage: That file is not a picture.

people.onlyHelp: One render: everyone in the picture gets this face, so describe a scene with this person alone.
people.othersHelp: The scene is made first. Then you click the face that should be this person, and only that face changes; everyone else keeps their own.
people.secondHelp: Photos of another person to put on another face in the same scene. Leave empty to keep whoever the scene makes.
people.addSecond: Add a photo of the second person

scene.title: Choose the faces
scene.help: Click the face that should be your person.
scene.helpSecond: Now click the face for the second person.
scene.noFaces: No faces were found in this scene. Try a new scene, or a closer shot in the description.

faces.noneHelp: PuLID would skip this photo. Use one where the face is larger, in focus, and seen from the front or at three-quarters.

consent.question: Do you have the right to use this person's likeness? It is your own photo, or the person agreed to this use.
consent.failed: The confirmation could not be saved: {{message}}

prompt.identityPlaceholder: A man driving a 1950s convertible down a Los Angeles boulevard, black and white film photo
prompt.identityHelp: Keep the face in view: a medium or close shot with the face toward the camera. In a wide or rear view the likeness has nowhere to show.
prompt.editPlaceholder: Put a red scarf around his neck
prompt.expandPlaceholder: Continue the street and the palm trees

settings.title: Settings
settings.strengthHelp: 1.0 is the measured default. Higher holds the face harder and can start to override the scene; lower lets the scene change the face more.
settings.stepsHelp: Leave empty for the model's own count.
settings.insideFrame: Only FLUX.1 Kontext is installed, so the picture keeps its size and the view widens inside it. Qwen-Image-Edit adds real canvas.

run.needFace: Every face photo needs a face the check can find.
run.needConsent: Confirm the likeness for every face photo.
run.needSides: Choose how far to extend at least one side.

job.lost: The backend restarted, so this run was lost. Start it again.

result.title: Result
result.empty: The result shows here. Your photos stay next to it so you can compare.

likeness.not_taken: Likeness {{score}}: the face did not take
likeness.no_face: No face in the result to compare
likeness.no_reference_face: Not measured: no face found in your photos
likeness.help: Measured after the render with the face-recognition model PuLID uses: the face in the result against the photos. Where the face took, renders scored 0.56 to 0.78; a different person 0.2 or less.
likeness.onMany: This face went onto {{count}} people. To put it on one of them, turn on “With other people”.
